coaches.label: Coaches' clients
coaches.title: Instagram DM Templates for Coaches
coaches.intro: Six copy-and-paste DM templates for fitness, health, life and business coaches who find clients on Instagram. Every one uses spintax, so each person you message gets different wording instead of the same copied script.
tips: Lead with them, not your offer
Your first message should be about their post, their goal or their situation. The pitch can wait until they reply.
Target people already looking
Followers of bigger coaches in your niche and people posting journey hashtags already want the result you sell.
Follow up twice, then stop
Most replies come from the first or second follow-up. A third is pushy; let the sequence end.
Test on a small batch first
Run 10 to 20 messages in Test Mode, read the previews, then scale the version that sounds most like you.

agencies.label: Business owners
agencies.title: Instagram DM Templates for Agencies
agencies.intro: Six cold DM templates for marketing agencies, freelancers and consultants who land clients by messaging business owners on Instagram. Each one spins its wording so no two owners get an identical pitch.
tips: Say something only they would recognise
Mention their business, their feed or a gap you noticed. Generic compliments read as spam.
Ask a question, don't pitch
A question about how they get customers opens a conversation; a price list in the first DM closes it.
Pick one local niche
Salons, barbers, dentists, gyms: a narrow list makes every template easier to personalise.
Move to a call quickly
Once they reply with interest, offer a short call instead of a long DM thread.

realestate.label: Home buyers
realestate.title: Instagram DM Templates for Real Estate Agents
realestate.h1: Instagram DM templates for real estate agents
realestate.intro: Six Instagram DM templates for realtors and estate agents reaching buyers, sellers and first-time movers. Spintax keeps every message sounding personal, even when you send them to a whole hashtag.
tips: Be the local expert, not a salesperson
Offer something useful, like an off-market list or a quick valuation, before asking for anything.
Target intent hashtags
People posting about house hunting, moving or renovating are already in the market.
Keep it about their move
Ask about their timeline and area. Buyers reply to questions about their plans, not about your listings.
Follow up slowly
Property decisions take time. Space follow-ups five to seven days apart.

creators.label: Creators
creators.title: Influencer Outreach DM Templates for Instagram
creators.intro: Six Instagram DM templates for brands and e-commerce stores reaching creators for UGC, gifting, paid collabs and affiliate deals. Every template spins its wording so creators don't get the same copy-paste pitch they see fifty times a week.
tips: Show you actually watched their content
Name a video or a style detail. Creators ignore pitches that could have gone to anyone.
Be upfront about the deal
Say whether it's paid, gifted or affiliate in the first or second message. Vague offers get ignored.
Go micro
Creators with 5k to 50k followers reply far more often and usually have better engagement.
Make saying yes easy
Ask one simple question: their rate, or where to send the product.

local.label: Locals
local.title: Instagram DM Templates for Local Businesses
local.h1: Instagram DM templates for local businesses
local.intro: Six Instagram DM templates for restaurants, cafés, salons, gyms and studios reaching people in their area. Spintax makes each invite feel personal, so it reads like a neighbour saying hello rather than an ad.
tips: Use location hashtags
People posting your city's food, fitness or lifestyle hashtags are the easiest locals to reach.
Give a reason to come in
A free first visit, a launch night or a local-only offer converts far better than 'check us out'.
Keep it warm and short
Two or three sentences, one emoji at most, and a clear yes-or-no question.
Ask happy customers for reviews
Message people who tagged you and ask for a quick review. It compounds.
